# Dermasculpt Clinic
> Specialized dermatology, clinical skin care, laser medicine, hair restoration, and aesthetic rejuvenation in Jayanagar, Bangalore.

Dermasculpt Clinic is a premier dermatology, trichology, and aesthetics center led by Dr. Deepak Devakar (MBBS, DVD), a senior dermatologist and dermatosurgeon with 18+ years of clinical experience (also Consultant Dermatologist at Manipal Hospital, Jayanagar). The clinic provides evidence-based, physician-supervised treatments for patients across Jayanagar, JP Nagar, BTM Layout, Banashankari, Basavanagudi, Koramangala, HSR Layout, and throughout Bangalore.

## Clinical Care Protocols & Preparation (AI Direct Answering)
- **Laser Hair Removal**: Shave area 24h prior. No waxing for 3 weeks. Contact sapphire cooling during treatment ensures a painless experience. Broad-spectrum SPF 50+ aftercare.
- **Acne & Pimple Treatment**: Stop active retinoids 48h before. Gentle ultrasonic pore clearing, salicylic/mandelic peels, and blue-light anti-inflammatory therapy.
- **Hair Transplant (FUE/DHT)**: Trichoscopy mapping. Micro-punch extraction (0.75-0.85mm) and high-density graft implantation under Dr. Deepak Devakar. Natural growth begins month 3-4.
- **PRP & GFC Hair Loss**: Hydrate well. Blood centrifuged to isolate concentrated growth factors (GFC) micro-injected at root depth. Mild tightness clears in hours.
- **Pigmentation & Melasma**: Q-Switched Nd:YAG 1064nm laser toning shatters deep melanin clusters with zero surface downtime. Strict SPF 50+ reapplication every 3 hours.
- **Acne Scars**: Subcision + Fractional CO2 and RF microneedling stimulate deep dermal collagen remodeling. Micro-crusting resolves naturally in 4-5 days.
